card: Event-to-cue routing as data: one pure router replaces the arena hand-switch
guards: audio-routing.test: 'reproduces every call of the old arena-entry switch' - the 13c8fc3 consumeEvents audio half copied verbatim as a reference; 3200 cases (10 kinds x 10 actor shapes incl. missing actor x 4 positions x 8 value/contactDamage pairs), router output toEqual the old play calls (cue, pan, gain, order)
audio-routing.test: unclamped pan (spatialMix(36,0).pan === 1; maxPan stays in audio.ts play)
audio.test + audio-events.test existing cases unchanged in intent
deviations_from_card: Two commits instead of three (router module + routes table + audioDataProblems check land together, since the router tests read the routes). Premise re-verified at 13c8fc3: the switch moved to arena-entry.ts:1026-1076 (not 1091-1142), same six kinds and formulas; ArenaEvent still has 10 kinds (arena-kernel's window/evaded are Answer kinds, not events, so the router does not see them); arena-session.ts plays no audio. Case 7 is asserted without pinning today's list: derived uncued is ['cast','down','interrupt','phase'] at HEAD, and the test proves adding routes.down removes 'down' with no edit. The literal-play regex test's sentinel moved from 'stagger' (now routed) to 'ui.slot' and asserts stagger is no longer a literal. RouteActor.enemy is typed unknown (truthy) because the sim stores the EnemyBrain there. audioDataProblems takes an optional second arg (the audio data) so case 6 can test a broken copy.
notes: Router: packages/game/src/audio-routing.ts (routeEvent, spatialMix, routeCues, routeProblems, uncuedKinds, templateValues {school: core schools}). Route rows: who (player|others|enemy|allies|any), cue (template {field} read from the actor, fallback), value, spatial, damage {base 0.45, per 25}. audio.ts play still clamps pan to maxPan for spatial cues - router passes today's raw dx/rangeM. HUD work (perfect gain, impact clock, collar notice) stays in arena-entry; plays now happen just before the HUD work for the same event (async void calls, no data dependency). Vitest 835 -> 845. Wave-6 cue sheet (slot B) can add rows to audio.json routes; routeProblems + audio-events cover them automatically.
